note: Every ready clip is 1080x1920, 30 fps, silent, trimmed to its usable range. Times in beats are seconds in the ready file. Gary is the gray terrier with the orange collar; Doug is the chocolate doodle.

clips.setting: park path, overcast, leash from above
beats: Gary lies flat on the asphalt path, chin down, leash taut up out of frame
the leash pulls; he does not move
eyes on the lens, completely unmoved, to the end
